title: Econ Onboarding Kit: Templates & Field Launch for Inference Frugality
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a reusable 'Econ Onboarding Kit' that product, solutions, and field engineering teams can use to run standardized batching, KV-cache, and quantization experiments with minimal setup. The kit will include experiment templates, a checklist for safety/regression validation, prebuilt dashboards, and rollout guidance so teams can adopt frugality knobs with predictable outcomes.
background: Many PMs and Engs run ad-hoc cost experiments that are hard to replicate and lack consistent success metrics. This increases cognitive load and slows adoption of batching/caching/quantization. The kit aims to lower the barrier by packaging validated templates, dashboards, and an OKR-aligned measurement framework.
goals: Provide three experiment templates (batching policy, KV-prefetch, quantized model variant) with baseline and treatment configs
Ship a lightweight dashboard template for token-econ and latency comparisons
Publish a validated rollout checklist and regression guardrails for production adoption
Enable first five internal teams to complete full onramp experiments within two weeks each
milestones: 2025-03-12: Internal pilot with Search team (metrics capture + dashboard)
2025-03-29: Field enablement sessions (2 workshops) and first external rollout guidance
2025-04-04: Kit v1 released and retro captured
success_metrics: Adoption: 5 internal teams complete kit experiments by release date
Savings: Average token-cost reduction >= 12% for pilot workloads where acceptable quality preserved
Reliability: No production regression incidents attributable to kit guidance in first 30 days
Time-to-experiment: average time from kickoff to measurable result <= 10 business days
tasks: Assemble experiment templates and sample configs for three workloads (chat, generation, embeddings)
Build dashboard templates (token-cost, p50/p95 latency, quality delta) and wiring instructions
Draft rollout checklist covering canary sizes, quality thresholds, rollback criteria, and monitoring hooks
Coordinate pilot runs with Search and Notifications teams and collect telemetry
Create a one-page playbook and a short video walkthrough for field enablement
risks: Quality regressions from aggressive quantization profiles not covered by the template
Teams may lack permissioned access to the telemetry required to measure token-econ
Overfitting templates to pilot workloads leads to poor generalization across customer workloads
Resource contention on Dedicated clusters during field pilots could skew cost/latency signals
rollout_plan: Phased: alpha templates -> two internal pilots -> iterate -> public kit v1. For each pilot, require a signed readiness checklist (metrics hooks + rollback plan) and run one controlled canary at 5% traffic. Post-candidate validation includes automatic quality guardrail tests and an 72-hour observation window prior to broader rollout.
notes: Keep templates modular: policies should be parameterized for sequence length and request mix. Prioritize clear instrumentation (token counts, cache hit rates) so KPI attribution is straightforward. Document common failure modes and remediation steps.
